subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should sessions_spawn expose a permanent deterministic skip mode, and if so should it be per-spawn only or also configurable as a persistent default?
rationale: Current main intentionally guarantees parent-facing completion handoff, while the request asks to suppress that handoff entirely; naming, precedence, and whether to add another config surface are product/API choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add per-spawn completion policy
options.body: Expose a narrow parent-or-skip parameter, preserve parent handoff as the default, and avoid adding global config until persistent demand is separately confirmed.

options.title: Add config and per-spawn policy
options.body: Support a default sub-agent completion policy plus a per-call override, accepting the larger configuration and precedence contract.

options.title: Keep mandatory parent handoff
options.body: Decline deterministic suppression because completion evidence should always return to the requester agent, leaving model tokens as the only silent path.

recommendation.title: Add per-spawn completion policy
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow parent-or-skip parameter, preserve parent handoff as the default, and avoid adding global config until persistent demand is separately confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged deterministic announce and descendant-gating architecture that the decision would extend.
